consumer: A detection/targeting check asking 'can the avatar currently SEE this specific monster?' — the engine's per-creature sight predicate (e.g. Character::sees(const Creature&)) over LOS and sight range
scope: per-monster visibility: the avatar's own LOS plus light/sight-range to that monster's tile, not a spatial bounding box
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities — it emits monsters from g->all_monsters() filtered only by in_export_window (a spatial window around the avatar), writing raw pos/hp/type with no LOS or sight computation
divergence: A monster standing inside the export window but behind a wall (or in darkness / beyond the avatar's sight range): it appears in entities.monsters[] and is treated as seen, yet Character::sees() returns false — the surface over-reports visibility
